def verify_session_id(request: Request,
                      db: Session = Depends(Backend.instance().get_db)) -> SessionDataDB | HTTPException:
    session_id = request.headers.get("x-session-id")

    if not (session_id and is_valid_guid(session_id)):
        session_id = request.query_params.get("x-session-id")

    if not (session_id and is_valid_guid(session_id)):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Missing X-Session-ID")

    user_session = db.query(SessionDataDB).filter(SessionDataDB.uuid == session_id).one_or_none()
    if not user_session:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid session")

    user_session.used += 1
    db.commit()

    return user_session
